content:
The test image shows a soybean leaf with numerous small, dark brown circular spots scattered across the leaf surface. Key features:
- Small (1-5mm), roughly circular lesions
- Dark brown centers with slightly reddish/purple borders
- Scattered uniformly across the green leaf
- Some spots appear to have lighter centers surrounded by darker rings

Comparing to the Frogeye leaf spot reference: the pattern matches very well — the reference shows identical small, dark circular spots with reddish-brown borders on otherwise green leaves, including the characteristic "shot hole" appearance where spot centers can fall out.

This is distinct from Septoria brown spot (which is more angular/irregular and causes prominent yellowing/defoliation) and Bacterial Blight (which has water-soaked lesions with yellow-green halos).
